ÇYD · 6th Grade · Theme 2 · Classroom Life

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ece's teacher explains a topic to the class in the usual classroom setting. Students listen and use their textbooks while the teacher leads the lesson. This approach is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) traditional learning

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece's teacher explains a topic to the class in the usual classroom setting. Students listen and use their textbooks while the teacher leads the lesson.” Bu tarif “traditional learning” kelimesine uyar; traditional learning = geleneksel öğrenme. Diğer şıklar: collaboration (iş birliği), differentiated instruction (farklılaştırılmış öğretim), group work (grup çalışması).

2

Selin's teacher uses quizzes and tasks to measure what students know. The results show their current understanding. This process is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) assessment

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin's teacher uses quizzes and tasks to measure what students know. The results show their current understanding.” Bu tarif “assessment” kelimesine uyar; assessment = ölçme. Diğer şıklar: mixed-ability classroom (karma yetenekli sınıf), presentation (sunum), brainstorming (beyin fırtınası).

3

Duru's teacher adds points, badges and levels to lesson tasks. These game elements make learning activities more engaging. This approach is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) gamification

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru's teacher adds points, badges and levels to lesson tasks. These game elements make learning activities more engaging.” Bu tarif “gamification” kelimesine uyar; gamification = oyunlaştırma. Diğer şıklar: curriculum (müfredat), feedback (geri bildirim), role-play (rol yapma).

4

Elif studies a short lesson video at home before class. In class, she practises the ideas and solves problems with her teacher. This approach is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) flipped classroom method

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif studies a short lesson video at home before class. In class, she practises the ideas and solves problems with her teacher.” Bu tarif “flipped classroom method” kelimesine uyar; flipped classroom method = ters yüz edilmiş sınıf yöntemi. Diğer şıklar: pair work (ikili çalışma), workshop (atölye çalışması), mixed-ability classroom (karma yetenekli sınıf).

5

Nehir's group needs ideas for a project. Everyone suggests as many ideas as possible before the group chooses or judges them. They use ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) brainstorming

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir's group needs ideas for a project. Everyone suggests as many ideas as possible before the group chooses or judges them.” Bu tarif “brainstorming” kelimesine uyar; brainstorming = beyin fırtınası. Diğer şıklar: differentiated instruction (farklılaştırılmış öğretim), presentation (sunum), gamification (oyunlaştırma).

6

Sena does a task with three classmates. Four students share ideas and complete one activity together. Their teacher calls this ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) group work

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena does a task with three classmates. Four students share ideas and complete one activity together.” Bu tarif “group work” kelimesine uyar; group work = grup çalışması. Diğer şıklar: workshop (atölye çalışması), traditional learning (geleneksel öğrenme), curriculum (müfredat).

7

İpek pretends to be a shop assistant in an English activity. Her partner acts as a customer, and they perform a short conversation. They do a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) role-play

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek pretends to be a shop assistant in an English activity. Her partner acts as a customer, and they perform a short conversation.” Bu tarif “role-play” kelimesine uyar; role-play = rol yapma. Diğer şıklar: pair work (ikili çalışma), assessment (ölçme), flipped classroom method (ters yüz edilmiş sınıf yöntemi).

8

Eylül and another school combine their ideas and resources for a shared goal. They cooperate and help one another throughout the project. This process is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) collaboration

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül and another school combine their ideas and resources for a shared goal. They cooperate and help one another throughout the project.” Bu tarif “collaboration” kelimesine uyar; collaboration = iş birliği. Diğer şıklar: feedback (geri bildirim), differentiated instruction (farklılaştırılmış öğretim), traditional learning (geleneksel öğrenme).

9

Cemre joins a video call on her computer. A small camera sends her live image to the other people. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) webcam

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre joins a video call on her computer. A small camera sends her live image to the other people.” Bu tarif “webcam” kelimesine uyar; webcam = web kamerası. Diğer şıklar: virtual reality (sanal gerçeklik), folder (klasör), database (veri tabanı).

10

Melis carries a computer that folds closed. Its screen and keyboard are connected in one portable unit. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) laptop

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis carries a computer that folds closed. Its screen and keyboard are connected in one portable unit.” Bu tarif “laptop” kelimesine uyar; laptop = dizüstü bilgisayar. Diğer şıklar: inequality (eşitsizlik), keyboard (klavye), printer (yazıcı).

11

Sıla uses a small electronic tool that fits in her hand. She can operate it while holding it, without placing it on a desk. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) handheld device

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla uses a small electronic tool that fits in her hand. She can operate it while holding it, without placing it on a desk.” Bu tarif “handheld device” kelimesine uyar; handheld device = elde taşınabilir cihaz. Diğer şıklar: touchscreen (dokunmatik ekran), interactive whiteboard (etkileşimli tahta), mouse pad (fare altlığı).

12

Defne wears a special headset. It lets her explore a computer-created three-dimensional world as if she is inside it. She experiences ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) virtual reality

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne wears a special headset. It lets her explore a computer-created three-dimensional world as if she is inside it.” Bu tarif “virtual reality” kelimesine uyar; virtual reality = sanal gerçeklik. Diğer şıklar: keyboard (klavye), laptop (dizüstü bilgisayar), database (veri tabanı).

13

Buse wants to organise her digital project files. She puts related files together in a named container on her computer. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) folder

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse wants to organise her digital project files. She puts related files together in a named container on her computer.” Bu tarif “folder” kelimesine uyar; folder = klasör. Diğer şıklar: handheld device (elde taşınabilir cihaz), webcam (web kamerası), interactive whiteboard (etkileşimli tahta).

14

İdil notices that some students have reliable Internet access while others have none. The students do not have equal opportunities to study online. This difference shows ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) inequality

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil notices that some students have reliable Internet access while others have none. The students do not have equal opportunities to study online.” Bu tarif “inequality” kelimesine uyar; inequality = eşitsizlik. Diğer şıklar: printer (yazıcı), mouse pad (fare altlığı), touchscreen (dokunmatik ekran).

15

Zeynep expects good things to happen, even when a task is difficult. She usually believes that the future can turn out well. She is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) optimist

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep expects good things to happen, even when a task is difficult. She usually believes that the future can turn out well.” Bu tarif “optimist” kelimesine uyar; optimist = iyimser. Diğer şıklar: objective (hedef), courage (cesaret), reward (ödül).

16

Mina studies how members of a project group interact. Their relationships, roles and behaviour affect how the group works. Together, these form its ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) team dynamic

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina studies how members of a project group interact. Their relationships, roles and behaviour affect how the group works.” Bu tarif “team dynamic” kelimesine uyar; team dynamic = takım dinamikleri. Diğer şıklar: benefit (fayda), performance (performans), preparation (hazırlık).

17

Pelin reads a long article. She writes only its main ideas in a much shorter form. She chooses to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) summarise

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin reads a long article. She writes only its main ideas in a much shorter form.” Bu tarif “summarise” kelimesine uyar; summarise = özetlemek. Diğer şıklar: clarify (açıklığa kavuşturmak), ensure (sağlamak, garanti etmek), evaluate (değerlendirmek).

18

Derya has a test tomorrow. She studies earlier topics again to refresh her memory. She needs to ______ them.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) revise

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya has a test tomorrow. She studies earlier topics again to refresh her memory.” Bu tarif “revise” kelimesine uyar; revise = gözden geçirmek, tekrar etmek. Diğer şıklar: overuse (aşırı kullanmak), boost (artırmak, güçlendirmek), monitor (izlemek, denetlemek).

19

Sena already has a good study routine. She wants to keep it going at the same useful standard. She tries to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) maintain

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena already has a good study routine. She wants to keep it going at the same useful standard.” Bu tarif “maintain” kelimesine uyar; maintain = korumak, sürdürmek. Diğer şıklar: secure (güvenli), accomplish (başarmak), overcome an obstacle (bir engeli aşmak).

20

Eda moves to a class with a different way of learning. She changes her habits to suit the new situation. She learns to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) adapt

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda moves to a class with a different way of learning. She changes her habits to suit the new situation.” Bu tarif “adapt” kelimesine uyar; adapt = uyum sağlamak. Diğer şıklar: revise (gözden geçirmek, tekrar etmek), boost (artırmak, güçlendirmek), ensure (sağlamak, garanti etmek).

21

Cem's group decides what it wants to achieve by the end of the project. This clear goal guides their work. It is their ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) objective

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem's group decides what it wants to achieve by the end of the project. This clear goal guides their work.” Bu tarif “objective” kelimesine uyar; objective = hedef. Diğer şıklar: creativity (yaratıcılık), mission (görev), privacy (gizlilik).

22

Eren gives all his attention to a difficult task. He ignores distractions and thinks only about his work. He uses his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) concentration

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren gives all his attention to a difficult task. He ignores distractions and thinks only about his work.” Bu tarif “concentration” kelimesine uyar; concentration = konsantrasyon. Diğer şıklar: challenge (zorluk), solution (çözüm), benefit (fayda).

23

Baran likes studying with pictures more than studying with sound recordings. This is the option he chooses when he can decide. It is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) preference

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran likes studying with pictures more than studying with sound recordings. This is the option he chooses when he can decide.” Bu tarif “preference” kelimesine uyar; preference = tercih. Diğer şıklar: courage (cesaret), optimist (iyimser), performance (performans).

24

Tolga's study plan can change when his needs change. He can adjust the times and tasks instead of keeping a fixed schedule. The plan is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) flexible

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga's study plan can change when his needs change. He can adjust the times and tasks instead of keeping a fixed schedule.” Bu tarif “flexible” kelimesine uyar; flexible = esnek. Diğer şıklar: verbal (sözlü), boring (sıkıcı), challenging (zorlayıcı).

25

Ozan explores a digital environment that surrounds his senses. He feels deeply involved, almost as if he is inside the experience. It is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) immersive

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan explores a digital environment that surrounds his senses. He feels deeply involved, almost as if he is inside the experience.” Bu tarif “immersive” kelimesine uyar; immersive = sürükleyici. Diğer şıklar: user-friendly (kullanıcı dostu), excited (heyecanlı), visual (görsel).

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Mert's class includes learners at different achievement levels. Some need basic help while others are ready for more advanced work. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) mixed-ability classroom

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert's class includes learners at different achievement levels. Some need basic help while others are ready for more advanced work.” Bu tarif “mixed-ability classroom” kelimesine uyar; mixed-ability classroom = karma yetenekli sınıf. Diğer şıklar: assessment (ölçme), workshop (atölye çalışması), brainstorming (beyin fırtınası).

2

Bora checks the official plan for his course. It sets out the content and skills students study during the year. This plan is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) curriculum

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora checks the official plan for his course. It sets out the content and skills students study during the year.” Bu tarif “curriculum” kelimesine uyar; curriculum = müfredat. Diğer şıklar: group work (grup çalışması), pair work (ikili çalışma), presentation (sunum).

3

Arda's teacher changes tasks to suit different learners' needs. Some students use extra support while others try more advanced tasks on the same topic. The teacher uses ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) differentiated instruction

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda's teacher changes tasks to suit different learners' needs. Some students use extra support while others try more advanced tasks on the same topic.” Bu tarif “differentiated instruction” kelimesine uyar; differentiated instruction = farklılaştırılmış öğretim. Diğer şıklar: role-play (rol yapma), flipped classroom method (ters yüz edilmiş sınıf yöntemi), traditional learning (geleneksel öğrenme).

4

Can attends a practical learning session. An expert guides the students as they build and test their own models. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) workshop

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can attends a practical learning session. An expert guides the students as they build and test their own models.” Bu tarif “workshop” kelimesine uyar; workshop = atölye çalışması. Diğer şıklar: gamification (oyunlaştırma), collaboration (iş birliği), feedback (geri bildirim).

5

Emir stands in front of his class. He uses slides and speaks to explain his project to an audience. He gives a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) presentation

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir stands in front of his class. He uses slides and speaks to explain his project to an audience.” Bu tarif “presentation” kelimesine uyar; presentation = sunum. Diğer şıklar: assessment (ölçme), curriculum (müfredat), group work (grup çalışması).

6

Baran does an activity with just one partner. The two students ask each other questions and check the answers. Their teacher calls this ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) pair work

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran does an activity with just one partner. The two students ask each other questions and check the answers.” Bu tarif “pair work” kelimesine uyar; pair work = ikili çalışma. Diğer şıklar: differentiated instruction (farklılaştırılmış öğretim), traditional learning (geleneksel öğrenme), gamification (oyunlaştırma).

7

Tolga finishes a project and shows it to his teacher. The teacher explains what is good and what he can improve. She gives him ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) feedback

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga finishes a project and shows it to his teacher. The teacher explains what is good and what he can improve.” Bu tarif “feedback” kelimesine uyar; feedback = geri bildirim. Diğer şıklar: brainstorming (beyin fırtınası), mixed-ability classroom (karma yetenekli sınıf), collaboration (iş birliği).

8

Ozan places a small flat surface beside his keyboard. He moves his computer mouse over it instead of directly on the desk. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) mouse pad

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan places a small flat surface beside his keyboard. He moves his computer mouse over it instead of directly on the desk.” Bu tarif “mouse pad” kelimesine uyar; mouse pad = fare altlığı. Diğer şıklar: keyboard (klavye), laptop (dizüstü bilgisayar), folder (klasör).

9

Yusuf does not use a mouse to choose an icon. He touches the display directly with his finger. The display is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) touchscreen

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yusuf does not use a mouse to choose an icon. He touches the display directly with his finger.” Bu tarif “touchscreen” kelimesine uyar; touchscreen = dokunmatik ekran. Diğer şıklar: database (veri tabanı), handheld device (elde taşınabilir cihaz), printer (yazıcı).

10

Aras's teacher uses a large electronic board at the front of the room. Students touch it to move objects and answer questions. It is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) interactive whiteboard

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aras's teacher uses a large electronic board at the front of the room. Students touch it to move objects and answer questions.” Bu tarif “interactive whiteboard” kelimesine uyar; interactive whiteboard = etkileşimli tahta. Diğer şıklar: inequality (eşitsizlik), webcam (web kamerası), virtual reality (sanal gerçeklik).

11

Gökçe types a report on her computer. She presses an object with letter, number and symbol keys. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) keyboard

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Gökçe types a report on her computer. She presses an object with letter, number and symbol keys.” Bu tarif “keyboard” kelimesine uyar; keyboard = klavye. Diğer şıklar: touchscreen (dokunmatik ekran), mouse pad (fare altlığı), laptop (dizüstü bilgisayar).

12

Kerem's school stores student records in an organised electronic collection. Staff can search the information and update individual records. This collection is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) database

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem's school stores student records in an organised electronic collection. Staff can search the information and update individual records.” Bu tarif “database” kelimesine uyar; database = veri tabanı. Diğer şıklar: inequality (eşitsizlik), webcam (web kamerası), virtual reality (sanal gerçeklik).

13

Deniz finishes a digital poster. He uses a machine to put the poster onto a sheet of paper. The machine is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) printer

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Deniz finishes a digital poster. He uses a machine to put the poster onto a sheet of paper.” Bu tarif “printer” kelimesine uyar; printer = yazıcı. Diğer şıklar: handheld device (elde taşınabilir cihaz), interactive whiteboard (etkileşimli tahta), folder (klasör).

14

Onur invents an original way to present his project. He uses imagination to produce new and unusual ideas. He shows ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) creativity

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Onur invents an original way to present his project. He uses imagination to produce new and unusual ideas.” Bu tarif “creativity” kelimesine uyar; creativity = yaratıcılık. Diğer şıklar: performance (performans), objective (hedef), preference (tercih).

15

Arda feels afraid of speaking on stage. He faces that fear and gives his talk anyway. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) courageous

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda feels afraid of speaking on stage. He faces that fear and gives his talk anyway.” Bu tarif “courageous” kelimesine uyar; courageous = cesur. Diğer şıklar: bored (sıkılmış), flexible (esnek), boring (sıkıcı).

16

Ali checks a project against a set of clear criteria. He judges its quality and decides how well it meets them. He needs to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) evaluate

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali checks a project against a set of clear criteria. He judges its quality and decides how well it meets them.” Bu tarif “evaluate” kelimesine uyar; evaluate = değerlendirmek. Diğer şıklar: revise (gözden geçirmek, tekrar etmek), accomplish (başarmak), summarise (özetlemek).

17

Efe does not understand an instruction. His teacher explains it more clearly and removes the confusion. She tries to ______ the instruction.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) clarify

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Efe does not understand an instruction. His teacher explains it more clearly and removes the confusion.” Bu tarif “clarify” kelimesine uyar; clarify = açıklığa kavuşturmak. Diğer şıklar: boost (artırmak, güçlendirmek), adapt (uyum sağlamak), maintain (korumak, sürdürmek).

18

Berk checks his plants' growth regularly. He records changes over time to keep track of their progress. He needs to ______ their growth.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) monitor

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berk checks his plants' growth regularly. He records changes over time to keep track of their progress.” Bu tarif “monitor” kelimesine uyar; monitor = izlemek, denetlemek. Diğer şıklar: secure (güvenli), ensure (sağlamak, garanti etmek), overcome an obstacle (bir engeli aşmak).

19

Burak spends far more time on his phone than he needs. He uses it so much that it interrupts his daily tasks. People can ______ technology in this way.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) overuse

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Burak spends far more time on his phone than he needs. He uses it so much that it interrupts his daily tasks.” Bu tarif “overuse” kelimesine uyar; overuse = aşırı kullanmak. Diğer şıklar: maintain (korumak, sürdürmek), revise (gözden geçirmek, tekrar etmek), adapt (uyum sağlamak).

20

Tuna wants to increase his confidence. His teacher gives useful support that makes his confidence stronger. Her support can ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) boost

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna wants to increase his confidence. His teacher gives useful support that makes his confidence stronger.” Bu tarif “boost” kelimesine uyar; boost = artırmak, güçlendirmek. Diğer şıklar: clarify (açıklığa kavuşturmak), evaluate (değerlendirmek), monitor (izlemek, denetlemek).

21

Aylin keeps her personal information away from people who do not need it. She controls who can see her private details. She protects her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) privacy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aylin keeps her personal information away from people who do not need it. She controls who can see her private details.” Bu tarif “privacy” kelimesine uyar; privacy = gizlilik. Diğer şıklar: team dynamic (takım dinamikleri), benefit (fayda), challenge (zorluk).

22

Nehir finds an effective answer to a problem. Her idea removes the difficulty and makes the system work again. She finds a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) solution

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir finds an effective answer to a problem. Her idea removes the difficulty and makes the system work again.” Bu tarif “solution” kelimesine uyar; solution = çözüm. Diğer şıklar: concentration (konsantrasyon), courage (cesaret), preparation (hazırlık).

23

İpek tries a new learning app. Its clear buttons and simple instructions make it easy to use. The app is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) user-friendly

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek tries a new learning app. Its clear buttons and simple instructions make it easy to use.” Bu tarif “user-friendly” kelimesine uyar; user-friendly = kullanıcı dostu. Diğer şıklar: verbal (sözlü), excited (heyecanlı), accessible (erişilebilir).

24

Eylül's new study method gives good results with little wasted time or effort. It helps her do useful work quickly. The method is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) efficient

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül's new study method gives good results with little wasted time or effort. It helps her do useful work quickly.” Bu tarif “efficient” kelimesine uyar; efficient = verimli. Diğer şıklar: challenging (zorlayıcı), visual (görsel), immersive (sürükleyici).

25

Cemre loses interest in an activity. It does not hold her attention, and she wants it to end. She finds it ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) boring

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre loses interest in an activity. It does not hold her attention, and she wants it to end.” Bu tarif “boring” kelimesine uyar; boring = sıkıcı. Diğer şıklar: advanced (ileri düzey), verbal (sözlü), accessible (erişilebilir).

Vocabulary Test 2 · Sonuç
